title: Scoring Engine Core
description: Implement scoring engine with 4-dimension weighted sum model, pipeline architecture, and generate_daily() integration.
acceptance_criteria: Default weights: signal=0.35, event=0.30, portfolio=0.20, market=0.15
generate_daily() returns list[WatchlistEntry] with priority_score and reason
Scoring is deterministic (identical inputs → identical outputs)
implementation_notes: Pipeline: ScoringFunction = Callable[[WatchlistEntry, ScoringContext], tuple[float, str]]
ScoringContext: events, signals, positions, target_date, config, market_data

convergence.definition_of_done: Engine implemented, generate_daily() works, determinism verified
